emails.subject: Evergreen Payments - repeated SLA failures
emails.body:
Hi Grace,

Evergreen Payments has missed the uptime SLA under our master services agreement for three straight months, and their latest outage took down order processing for two days. We want to send a formal notice of breach. The MSA is attached.

Best regards,
Valerie
Chief Operating Officer
Trellis Labs

emails.subject: Response to notice of breach
emails.body:
Grace,

We disagree that the outages constitute a material breach. Most of the downtime was caused by your client's own configuration changes. Our client is nevertheless willing to discuss service credits without prejudice.

Thanks,
Lucia
Partner
Brennan & Patel LLP

emails.subject: Damages model
emails.body:
Hello Grace,

First cut at the damages model: lost revenue during the outages is roughly $780,000, plus cover costs for the replacement vendor. The limitation of liability clause may cap us at 12 months of fees unless we can show gross negligence.

Thanks,
Gabriel Lee
